mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 37 degrees under clear skies at Verona City Hall with a full moon visible. The overnight low will reach 31 degrees, and no rain is expected.
City offices and the recycling center will be closed on November 26 and 27 for Thanksgiving. Additionally, Thursday trash and recycling collection will be pushed back to Friday, November 27.
Looking at the calendar for the next 30 days, there are currently no local events scheduled for the city.
Reviewing the weekly report, on November 8, a single vehicle collision occurred on South Main Street where a driver was arrested for O W I after striking a light pole.
You can still stop by Culver's tonight to enjoy the OREO Cookie Overload flavor of the day before they close their doors at 10 PM.
